about: Hand-written by Claude on 2026-10-19 after re-reading all 62 test-split reviews and redoing their arithmetic. Orders the review packet, least sure first. Every test review not listed here is 'high': the verdict is arithmetic on the text as annotated, and the text is unambiguous. Read by python -m opt_agent.packets reviews.
